rationale: The evidence file log/tab_ipw_hhinc_pw.scsv (Table 9) reports coefficients on the import-exposure regressor (row 'd_t~eusch_pw'). Columns 1-6 are the percent-change specifications (Panel A) and columns 7-12 the dollar-change specifications (Panel B). Every cell matches the paper to essentially full precision: Panel A total -1.476 (paper -1.48), wage-salary -2.142 (-2.14), business/invest -0.510 (-0.51), SocSec+AFDC +2.119 (+2.12), median total -1.732 (-1.73), median wage-salary -2.320 (-2.32); Panel B total -492.636 (-492.6), wage-salary -549.332 (-549.3), business/invest +40.137 (+40.1), SocSec+AFDC +17.317 (+17.3), median total -439.868 (-439.9), median wage-salary -476.486 (-476.5). All 12 cells are well within 5% relative error (most exact to the reported rounding). fix_severity.json shows only a trivial matplotlib install with no impact on the statistical results. This is a clean match.
